title: Federated Agent Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.01195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in private environments and accumulate valuable experience from task execution, tool use, feedback, and local knowledge. Yet such experience is distributed across organizations and cannot be directly shared because of privacy and proprietary constraints. Conventional federated learning is insufficient for this setting, as agent capabilities extend beyond model parameters to memory, tools, rewards, skills, and structured knowledge. In this paper, we formulate \textbf{Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)}, which studies how distributed agents can collaboratively improve through controlled information exchange while keeping raw data, complete trajectories, and private knowledge local. We define FAO as a multi-objective problem balancing agent utility, privacy leakage, and communication cost, and organize its optimization space across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and structured knowle

translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地在私有环境中运行，并从任务执行、工具使用、反馈和本地知识中积累宝贵经验。然而，这些经验分散在各个组织之间，由于隐私和专有性限制而无法直接共享。传统联邦学习不足以应对这种场景，因为智能体的能力不仅限于模型参数，还扩展到记忆、工具、奖励、技能和结构化知识。在本文中，我们提出了联邦智能体优化（FAO），研究分布式智能体如何通过受控的信息交换实现协同改进，同时将原始数据、完整轨迹和私有知识保留在本地。我们将FAO定义为一个多目标问题，需要平衡智能体效用、隐私泄露和通信成本，并将其优化空间组织为策略、记忆、工具使用、奖励和结构化知识等维度。
tldr: 提出了联邦智能体优化（FAO）新范式，使分布式LLM智能体能够在保护隐私的前提下，通过受控信息交换在策略、记忆、工具、奖励和知识等多个维度实现协同改进。
en_tdlr: Proposes Federated Agent Optimization (FAO), a new paradigm enabling distributed LLM agents to collaboratively improve across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and knowledge dimensions through controlled information exchange while preserving privacy.
